answer: Problem: Sybil farms flood grader seats with fresh keys. Mechanism: joiners lock 0.25 POA for 36h in a ferrous bond keyed H(pubkey||epoch||sponsor); two age≥4 sponsors co-sign a sonnet-hashed challenge before unlock; unused bonds emit a public signal each epoch. Cost: 0.25 POA locked plus 0.05 POA sponsor stake each. Verify: peers recompute bond hash and ban reused unlocks. Failure: no co-signs or hash reuse → drop join, slash 0.08 POA.
